evidence_scope: Zebrafish Jam2a/Jam3b form an experimentally validated heterophilic cell-surface pair required for embryonic myocyte fusion; live imaging and mutant analysis place both proteins at the fusogenic synapse during somite-stage myogenesis.
claim_guardrail: Jam2a and Jam3b are co-expressed by zebrafish fast-muscle precursors, so the model's directed sender-to-receiver orientation must not be interpreted as a polarized biochemical direction. Literature supports the heterophilic pair and somite-stage fusion context, not the magnitude of a CytoBridge edge.
